lesson.menu_desc: A friend who finally booked it, a course paid for on a whim and a client who wants a third revision -- 33 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 11 -- Enjoy Working, Want to Work
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ana Luiza Sellmann | Lesson 11 -- Enjoy Working, Want to Work

listenings.text: So I did the thing. I stopped saying next year and I actually booked it. You know I have been promising to take that ceramics course since we met, and every January I decide to start and then I avoid looking at the website until March. This time I did not hesitate. I paid for the whole term on a Tuesday afternoon, on a whim, and now I cannot get the money back, which is exactly why I did it that way. The first class is on the ninth. I am reluctant to tell my mother, because she will want to come with me, and she is even more stubborn than I am. Anyway, that is my news. Eventually I will learn to do things without a deadline forcing me.

Ana, before you reply to that email, two things. The client has asked to add two more cities, which means the scope has changed, and they seem to expect us to absorb it. I would avoid agreeing to anything in writing today. Second, they want a third revision of the film, and we had agreed to two. I suggest offering one more revision and asking them to pay for the extra cities. Renata refused to sign anything last week until the numbers were clear, and she was right. So please do not promise to deliver in March. Just say we need to review the scope, and that you will come back to them on Thursday.

extra_audio.text: Caio says he asked for three months off and that his boss agreed to keep his job open. Ana points out that he has been talking about that trip for two years. Caio explains that he kept planning it and then finding a reason to wait. Caio says his sister refused to listen to his excuses and offered to look after the flat. Ana admits she has not considered asking for one month instead of three.
